title: Half-up rounding applies at each stated precision and a totals cell may differ from the eye-summed rows by one last-decimal unit — expected
preconditions: 1. Several invoices with odd cent/decimal values sit under one rep (seed ZZAUTOTEST data with values like $10.005).
steps: 1. Read the displayed per-invoice values, sum them by hand, and compare with the rep summary and Totals cells.
expected: 1. All displayed values round half-up (away from zero) at their stated precision — money to cents; Inv. Hrs and Margin % to one decimal.
2. Rolled-up values are computed from UNROUNDED components and then rounded, so a totals cell may differ from the eye-summed displayed rows by one unit in the last decimal.
3. That one-unit difference is EXPECTED behavior per the spec — it must NOT be filed as a calculation defect.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: KNOWN-LIMITATION ENCODING: the last-decimal totals discrepancy is by design.
